sections.overview: A long-armed octopus of Indo-Malayan shallows.
sections.identification: Small stalked eyes and fixed white bars mark its reddish body.
sections.habitat: It lives on shallow soft sediments.
sections.diet: It traps buried crustaceans and fish beneath its arms and web.
sections.behavior: It forages at dawn and dusk, probing holes with its arms.
sections.reproduction: The cited description gives no reproductive details.
sections.ecology: Its pattern intensifies when disturbed; a warning role is only a hypothesis. It is closely related to the mimic octopus, Thaumoctopus mimicus; see its profile.
sections.conservation: It is traded for photography and aquaria; wild trends were not assessed.
